text:
devon: Heads-up — release window closes 3pm PT tomorrow. Please make sure each PR has a one-line release-note in the PR description and the `release-ready` label. I'll do a sweep at 2:30pm PT and add placeholders for anything missing. If you need a backport, ping me here.

maria: ack. I'll add one-liners to my open PRs (PR #3421, #3456).

alex: quick question — are we still using the same tiny template (component: short description (PR #...))? any preferred tense/format?

dana: yes — keep it compact. Prefer present-tense, component tag optional but helpful. Example snippet to copy:```ui: compacted settings dropdown to reduce vertical space (PR #3456)```

devon: copy that. For automation, I'm running this to surface missing notes:```bash
gh pr list --repo redwood/inference --state open --label needs-release-note --json number,title,author
```I'll paste results here if anything is urgent.

deploy-bot: :bell: Reminder: release cutoff ~24 hours. If you want to opt out, add `release-skip` and a short reason. Template + examples: <https://redwood.dev/release-notes-template>.

maria: thanks for the link. Also adding `release-ready` to #3456 now. :thumbsup:

alex: pinging @dana for wording review on #3421 — small API surface change, want to avoid confusing customers.

dana: on it, will suggest wording. For API changes please include migration notes if applicable. Example for API one-liner:```api: expose max_prompts param on /v1/generate (PR #3421) - no user migration required```. 

devon: FYI I'll standardize placeholders to the form `misc: internal refactor (PR #NNNN)` when I add them during the sweep. If you want more detail, update your PR before 2:30.

alex: is there a preferred location in the PR? top comment vs description?

dana: description is best. CI picks it up from there. If you paste into a top comment the changelog bot might not see it.

devon: quick operational note: if you add `release-exempt` we won't force a placeholder, but leave a clear reason. Otherwise I'll add the placeholder to reduce review overhead.

maria: small heads-up: two external contributor PRs need author attribution in the note — I'll add `(contrib: @janedoe)` to their one-liners.

deploy-bot: [automated] Cutoff in 12 hours. Current missing-release-note count: 7.

dana: nit: please avoid `fixes` language in the one-liner unless it's a customer-facing bugfix; use neutral verbs: "reduces", "improves", "adds".

devon: good call. I'll run a quick regex to swap `fixes` -> `fix` -> keep neutral when I add placeholders.

alex: thanks — I'll make updates now.

maria: done for my PRs. thanks for the sweep offer, devon.

devon: closing loop — doing sweep at 2:30 PT, will only add placeholders and label. If you need a human wording pass, flag me before then. After sweep I'll post a short list of PR numbers I changed.

(ends)
